archetypes.name: dyn-step6-routing
archetypes.rationale: Step 6 now owns mixed change-detection and composite routing envelopes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 6 Python entrypoint and SKILL.md routing contract together. Focus on FILES_CHANGED parsing, single NEXT_ACTION emission, stall seeding, and 7.r CHECKPOINT_NEXT ordering. Verify force-checks re-entry cannot skip checks after repair. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-harness-pins
archetypes.rationale: Several static harnesses pin launcher strings and timeout tuple shapes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed structure, rebase, fence-shape, and anti-halt harnesses against the new Step 6 launcher. Check for stale checks-commit-route pins, mismatched timeout tuple strings, and overbroad forbids that could hide legitimate Step 3 or self-review composite launchers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
